    for c in range(5):
        v=grid[6+r][c]
        if v: grid[6+r][6+(4-c)]=v
        v=grid[6+r][12+c]
        if v: grid[6+r][18+(4-c)]=v
        v=grid[18+r][6+c]
        if v: grid[18+r][4-c]=v
import json
print(json.dumps(grid,separators=(',',':')))
